page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6a.2xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by AMD EPYC 7H12 processors running at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, the configuration allocates 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with two threads per core. The hardware environment is provisioned with 64 GB of main memory, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU distribution. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage architectures. Networking capabilities feature a baseline throughput of 2 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

Benchmark analysis positions the system primarily within middle-tier operational tiers, accompanied by specific computing bottlenecks. Synthetic evaluations reveal lower percentile metrics in sustained CPU stress tests, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core throughput ranking in bottom percentiles. However, standard execution loads demonstrate stable mid-range results, characterized by a PassMark CPU score of 10308.35, a Geekbench multi-core rating of 4891.0, and balanced single-threaded gzip compression at 23.91 GB/sec. Memory subsystem evaluation indicates responsive small-block cached read bandwidth of 400.15 GB/sec, whereas uncached large-block read and write bandwidths taper off to 30.8 GB/sec and 15.87 GB/sec respectively.

From a cost-efficiency and architectural standpoint, the instance delivers high memory density without incurring the expense of larger multi-core compute allocations. The absence of local solid-state drives requires careful planning around network-attached storage latency and bandwidth quotas. Given the 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU allocation, average database operation scores, and high in-memory key-value execution reaching 7.13 million Redis SET operations per second, this server profile matches in-memory caching layers, Redis deployments, relational database engines, and medium-scale web serving infrastructures.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6a.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance engineered for workloads requiring high memory capacity relative to compute resources. Driven by AMD EPYC 7H12 processors running at 2.6 GHz, the instance provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores on an x86_64 architecture with hyper-threading. It includes 64 GB of memory, yielding an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, paired with 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and no bundled local storage or dedicated GPUs. Benchmark results display middle-tier performance across general compute and cryptographic tasks, including a PassMark CPU score of 10308.35 and Geekbench multi-core rating of 4891.0, though pure synthetic CPU stress tests and large-block memory write bandwidth remain in lower percentiles. The hardware architecture offers cost efficiency for memory-heavy operations without paying for surplus compute cores, making it well fitted for in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, and intermediate database operations.
